posts.title: Making a QR Code Quilt, Again
posts.description: I really like projects that explore the overlap of traditional crafts and computing / digital technology. Some of my favourite examples of this include Madeleine Shepard's hacked knitting machine cellular automata , adversarial print that protects against surveillance cameras , and Charlie’s quiltagon project . posts.title: My PyData London 2026 Conference Highlights
posts.description: PyData London is a conference bringing together data scientists and engineers from all over the world for workshops and talks covering everything from document parsing to weather forecasting.
